name: Ultimate Deconvolution
prior: IID theta_j from sum_k pi_k N_R(0,U_k); optional scale-adjusted IW or NN covariance penalty
inference_algorithm: Penalized marginal-likelihood fitting by mixture EM with TED, ED or FA covariance updates as applicable; analytic plug-in posterior
estimand: Posterior distributions, means, standard deviations and local false sign rates for theta_j
data_input: Observed R-dimensional effect-estimate vectors x_j and known invertible error covariance matrices V_j
tunable_settings: Number of mixture components K; covariance constraints; penalty choice; penalty strength lambda (may be selected by cross-validation); fitting initialization and convergence criterion
